summary: The sign-in front works again, and support scripts sign in in more situations.

new.title: Script for least database rights
new.text: A new support script sets PIM Manager's database access to the least rights each part needs.

fixes.title: Sign-in front works again
fixes.text: The previous sign-in front update failed on every page. It now works and keeps longer-lasting sessions.

fixes.title: Support scripts sign in more reliably
fixes.text: Support scripts reach a private database from inside the network without a firewall rule, and sign in when localhost means IPv6 or a machine identity is present.
